item: Interactions (`module.decoration.interactions`: click, hover or scroll triggers that start an effect on another element)
reason: not built, so not taught. Divi 5.15.1 reads the saved list in includes/builder-5/server/Packages/Module/Options/Interactions/InteractionsScriptData.php:128-160 (each entry needs an id, a triggerClass, a trigger, an effect and a target class, which the builder generates), but the lists of valid triggers and effects live only in the builder's JavaScript, no real export of an interaction is held, and a hand-written entry could not be checked against a source or an export. Never probed

item: Hover on a row, column, section, image, blurb or any module other than the group, heading and button measured here
reason: not rendered: hover was measured on `divi/group` (module-level background, border, box shadow, transform, filters), on `divi/heading` (title text colour) and on `divi/button` (button background, text and border colour, plus the module-level box shadow and scale). Other hosts use the same option groups (module.json lists them) but were not rendered

reason: dead: candidates mo-hv-button-shadow and mo-hv-button-scale changed nothing at any width although the button's module.json lists those groups under `button`. The module-level paths (`module.decoration.boxShadow`, `module.decoration.transform`) rendered and are the ones taught

reason: not rendered: the probe measured the desktop hover state only. Touch screens have no hover, so a hover-only effect is not a phone design
